title: Interim Financial Reporting and Impairment
summary: Addresses the interaction between IAS 34 and the impairment requirements of IAS 36 for goodwill, and historically for investments in equity instruments and financial assets carried at cost.

related.title: Interim Financial Reporting
related.relationship: Supplies the interim-reporting framework and the general principle that interim periods follow annual recognition and measurement principles

related.title: Impairment of Assets
related.relationship: Supplies the absolute no-reversal rule for goodwill that IFRIC 10 extends explicitly to interim periods

related.title: Financial Instruments
related.relationship: Superseded IAS 39's equity-instrument impairment model, narrowing IFRIC 10's practical scope to goodwill

related.title: Business Combinations
related.relationship: Governs the initial recognition of goodwill that IFRIC 10's no-reversal principle protects from write-back
